{{Quote|For too long, we have bent over backwards doing business with both sides, when these lesser factions are mere insects compared to our glorious and long-lived people! Why should we bother negotiating with creatures who are only fit to be slaves?|Toborro's speech to fellow Cartel members upon his rise to power|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Toborro''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the resulting [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
Toborro had at some point lost his left arm and a finger on his right hand. However, Toborro had risen high up into the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], eventually becoming the [[Supreme Mogul]], succeeding [[Karagga]] the Unyielding,<ref name="CoM" /> who was killed during the [[Battle of Karagga's Palace|siege of his palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] a year earlier. As the new head of the Hutt Cartel, Toborro was paranoid and ruthless, with no tolerance for failure from his subordinates, and ever watchful for betrayal by his allies.<ref name="ToborroCodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Toborro the Hutt}}</ref>

Believing it to be his mandate and his destiny, Toborro sought to establish the Hutt Cartel as a dominant superpower and end the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], believing them to be "lesser factions" only fit to be slaves.<ref name="ToborroCodex" /> The campaign was to begin on [[Makeb]], an independent world on the border between [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and the Galactic Republic.<ref name="CoM" /> Makeb was the only source in the galaxy for [[isotope-5]], a rare mineral with tremendous gravity-warping properties that could be harnessed as a power source, even in small quantities. To that end, he purchased the loyalty of the [[InterStellar Regulators]], the mercenary militia hired by Makeb's population as its defense force, to [[Conquest of Makeb|subjugate the planet]]. Toborro personally oversaw the operations from [[Toborro's Palace|his palace]] on the surface and had no compunction with ordering the elimination of the entire planet's population to achieve his ambitions.<ref name="ToborroCodex" />

Recognizing that the deep-core drilling would spell Makeb's doom, Toborro instituted "Project Failsafe", involving the construction of a massive starship, "[[the Ark]]," at a mesa known the [[Giant's Spear]]. The ship would carry Toborro, his chosen retinue, and his entire supply of isotope-5, while leaving Makeb to its fate.<ref name="Failsafe">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Failsafe|Makeb}}</ref> Republic special forces, acting at the behest of [[Makeb Business Council]] leader [[Shalim Avesta]] and his resistance movement, discovered the truth of the project at the Hutt Embassy in [[Talaos City]], Makeb's capital, and proceeded to take control of the Ark for evacuating Makeb's citizens.<ref name="Ark">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|The Ark|Makeb}}</ref> After the loss of the Ark and the destruction of much of the Regulators' arsenal, Toborro unleashed isotope-5 war droids against the city of [[Tarlam]], swearing to slaughter Makeb's people until Avesta and the Republic surrendered the Ark.<ref name="HtH">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Hitting the Hutts|Makeb}}</ref>

===Downfall===
{{Quote|A single drop of isotope-5 could level this palace! I just set fire to a whole lake of it! Prepare for flaming death!|Toborro's last words|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Toborro_full.png|thumb|right|200px|Toborro sitting on his throne.]]
Realizing that Toborro was mad, the Hutt Cartel leadership formally shunned him and negotiated with the Republic to escape from Makeb. Now on his own, Avesta demanded that Toborro surrender the isotope-5 fuel rods required for the Ark to fly. Toborro insanely declared that he held the ultimate power, his fortress would withstand Makeb's destruction, and that when his enemies were dead, only he would remain.<ref name="Surgery">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Planetary Surgery|Makeb}}</ref>

Toborro's former chief scientist and engineer, Dr. [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]], had defected shortly before the remainder of the Cartel leaders, and revealed that he had installed a secret entrance into Toborro's palace, one that not even the Hutt leader knew about. The Republic forces entered the palace through the secret entrance and faced Toborro in his throne room. The fuel rods were held by an advanced isotope-5 droid, "[[Toborro's Glittering Fury]]." Despite the power of the advanced droid, the Republic forces did destroy it. Enraged, Toborro set his entire supply of isotope-5 ablaze, intending to destroy himself and his enemies in one fell swoop. Ultimately, Toborro was destroyed as his palace collapsed.<ref name="ToT" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|That inbred imbecile has abandoned all sanity.|Doctor [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] on Toborro.|<ref name="TOR" />}}
During the [[Conquest of Makeb|Hutt invasion of]] [[Makeb]], Toborro became paranoid about his rule and started to lose touch with reality. As the invasion was nearing to an end, Toborro felt that the leading members of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Cartel]] were going to betray him.<ref name="Hutt Cartel Alliance">"{{TORcite|type=codex|Hutt Cartel Alliance}}"</ref> Because of this and several events, Toborro proved to "abandon all sanity," which [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb|Oggurobb]] mentioned and commented on, adding that Toborro was an "inbred imbecile," during the plot to get into [[Toborro's Palace]].

Prior to the invasion, at some point, Toborro lost his left arm and a finger on his right hand, which he replaced with a prosthetic claw and a prosthetic finger. Toborro also wore a type of clothing around his neck and a red-colored wrap around his right arm, something not common for [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] to wear, however which was not the case for another Hutt leader by the name of [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]], who wore a cap and a wrap around his torso.<ref name="Oruba">"{{SWE|characters|oruba-the-hutt|Oruba the Hutt}}"</ref> Toborro appeared to have dark purple skin and red eyes.

==Behind the scenes==
Toborro first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', an expansion added in [[2012]] to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

The manner of Toborro's death is determined by the actions of the player. The light side choice is to simply leave Toborro to his fate, and he is killed by a series of explosions from behind his throne. The dark side option is to bring about Toborro's death personally by bringing the ceiling down on his head, crushing him.
